items.question: How long does it take to see results?
items.answer: It depends on your starting point and objectives. Generally, first results appear in 30-60 days. Solid authority is built in 6-12 months of consistent work.

items.question: Do you guarantee results?
items.answer: We guarantee total commitment and high-level strategy. Results also depend on your involvement in the process. We only work with those willing to do their part.

items.question: What's the investment?
items.answer: The investment varies according to scope and objectives. After the initial conversation, we present a customized proposal. We don't work with generic packages.

items.question: Do you work with any professional?
items.answer: No. We only work with professionals who have a solid foundation and are ready to assume an authority position. Our selection process is rigorous.

items.question: How does confidentiality work?
items.answer: Confidentiality is non-negotiable. All clients and projects are treated with absolute secrecy. Many of our most successful clients will never be publicly mentioned.

items.question: Do you manage social media?
items.answer: Not directly. Our focus is strategic positioning and traditional media presence. We can guide your social media team to align with the overall strategy.
